chapters.title: Chapter 1901 Kent's Master Plan
paragraphs: "Soul Monarch, doesn't ring a bell," Kent said, not really bothered by the fact that an unknown person had given his wife such a grand inheritance.
His focus is mostly on the fact that his wife will soon inherit one of the seven grandest legacies in all the Multiverse.
Of course, while he had no idea who the mysterious Soul Monarch was, Elsa seemed to have some idea.
However, judging by the look on her face, it was clear she didn't know the person, though the name seemed to have triggered something within her.
Maybe it had something to do with her past life.
But since nobody seemed to notice, she didn't bother to say anything.
Right now, the focus was on Neomi, who was about to embark on a journey to a place she had never expected she would one day go.
She had no need for that legacy in the past, so she never bothered to go after it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1902 This is not a Goodbye
paragraphs: "MmmmmhhHHH"

Neomi moaned, her breath catching as she gripped Kent's shoulder tightly, her eyes barely open. Kent held on to her ass and thrust deep inside, causing her body to spasm whenever his load shot inside her.
After a few more rounds, which, if counted, brought the total to 45, Kent finally pulled out, not willing to go into a 46th round, which he knew Neomi wouldn't be able to endure.
Since she would be leaving for a very long time, Kent decided to spend more than the two months he had planned to spend with most of his wives. This was so that she wouldn't miss him too much.
So, with the harem tower reserved by them, they had been going at it for months. Luckily, Neomi had the stamina to handle that many rounds.
In the end, things had to come to an end, and so they did. Now, watching her lie down, her back pressed against a stack of pillows, Kent smiled and reached for her hand.
"I am going to miss you, Neomi."

chapters.title: Chapter 1903 Flame Paradise
paragraphs: Sometime later, after making sure he spent some more time with his wives, Kent was ready to head over to the Flame Paradise with the mission of retrieving his Blood Spear, the weapon he wielded during the Blood Era.
Of course, he didn't plan on going alone this time.
He would be going with Alina, whom he planned to help complete her Battlefield Matrix, the next-generation formation he planned to build into something this universe had never seen before.
The more Kent heard about her plans, the more intrigued he became. He would be travelling with her this time, and hopefully, by the time they returned, she would be able to complete the first phase.
Before leaving, however, he made sure to put measures in place for Kaizo to start his training.
It was just 100 years.

However, even if the time difference inside the tower made it several hundred years for him, that was still not enough time to train. Then again, it was Kaizo; even if he had a year to prepare, he would be ready in 6 months' time.

"I know the kind of warrior you are, Kaizo, so I won't bother telling you how serious the mission we have in 100 years' time is. But to make sure you are aware, train well because no matter what, the duel will be a next-level kind of danger, so do your best to break your limits before I return."

chapters.title: Chapter 1904 Their Insidious Plans
paragraphs: [A week after Kent and Alina left - Tower Time]
A week after Kent and Alina left for the Flame Paradise, his wives, including those who had yet to join and those who were not sure yet, met in the Harem Tower to plan some missions.
In attendance was also the Second Flame Matriarch, who, after she defeated Ruby, had been meditating inside the Legion Tower.
The ladies knew she didnt follow Kent out of goodwill, so they allowed her to be.
She didn't even bother to comment on the challenge the Blood Race had thrown at the Infinity Universe. To her, if Kent were to die in that challenge, she would finally be free.

But despite her dislike for Kent, she found herself getting drawn into the shenanigans of his wives, especially after they deliberately waited for Kent to leave before they put their insidious plans into motion.
They knew if Kent were around, he wouldn't allow them to do that. So they waited for him to leave before making their move.

chapters.title: Chapter 1905 Meiko's Anger (1)
paragraphs: It is a good thing Kent left before his wives decided to embark on this mission.
They know his relationship with the Forsaken Race, while a bit better now, thanks to finally learning more about them from Safira, is still bad, as he hates them in general.
They took someone very dear to him, and inasmuch as one would say that while Elina was alive, he didn't tell her how he felt, so her death shouldn't have affected him that much, it did.
And because he wasn't that emotionally intelligent back then, when he tapped into his hatred, it became everything he knew.
That hatred still burns in his soul, and now that he knows just how much he has lost, it would take more than a simple explanation to calm his anger.
His wives knew that much, so they were willing to do something to better sate his anger.
If all goes according to plan, they will soon host a meeting between one of the three Forsaken leaders and Kent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1906 Meiko's Anger (2)
paragraphs: Although they came to gather information the normal way, that doesn't mean they intended to go door to door and question the people. They knew it would take more than that to find what they were looking for.
Luckily, they had someone who could help them get the information they needed without much struggle.

After booking a table, Pandora used her superior senses to find the owner, who was, surprisingly, a True God. Thanks to his weak cultivation method, Zaila was summoned and, using her insidious mental abilities, she entered the man's head and compelled him to talk to them.
A few minutes after she was done, a man clad in a wavy cloak approached their table.

"Sorry, Fairies, I didn't know such beauties as yourselves would be gracing this humble Inn with your presence today," he bowed, causing many inside the Inn to wonder why such a dignified man, known all over this planet, would bow to these ladies.
On the side, Vexthra and her sisters turned and looked at Zaila, who blushed and hid her face.
They knew the only way such a man would lower himself to speak with them was if Zaila had done more than plant the idea that compelled him to come to them.

In truth, Zaila wanted to extract his memories because, to her, that was the most effective way to obtain their information. However, since extraction was more difficult than planting, they made her plant the idea instead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1907 Meiko's Anger (3)
paragraphs: "If you are watching this, then know we are all dead. I don't know how they found us, but they did, and now, I am the only one remaining." The man in the display spat a mouthful of blood.
"My lady, I am so sorry I couldn't protect Lady Inkala from those monsters. I don't know if they will kill her or enslave her, but I do hope that they kill her, for that would be mercy.
The idea of them enslaving her eats at my sanity and conscience as a person. I will never wish that on even my enemies," He spat blood again.
"I couldn't do much, but all we have gathered on them is in this manual. If you return one day, please avenge us."
The projection cut, and then the formation changed color, sending a sharp light throughout the room and forcing everyone to shield their eyes.
When it receded, a blood-covered manual appeared, and Meiko, with trembling hands, picked it up and opened it. Her sisters rushed to her side and began reading together.

"They called themselves the Grim Arcane Legends, a secret organization formed by one of the Nine Great Families. At first, they were a mystery, but later on, we discovered that they are tied to the De Marcus Great Family in the Eastern Celestial Zone.
"Apparently, this Great family was affiliated with Inkala, and so they had been searching for her. When we discovered this, we moved her from her planet to the Supreme Realm, but they followed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1908 And Angry Ruby Is a Dangerous Ruby
paragraphs: "That is Young Master Justin. He is known for—"
Before the owner of the inn could finish what he was saying, Ruby turned into blood mist and vanished from the basement.
"Oh, this is bad," Dia said quickly, making her way up the stairs. The rest of her sisters followed, knowing that what was about to happen, if not prevented, would cause blood to flow.
On the outside, a young man with beautiful brown hair stood in front of a carriage, with over ten guards, each a Celestial, guarding him.
He held a smug expression on his face, which showed the kind of person he was and why his death would make so many people very happy.
Many wish him death, but luckily for him, over the years, he had never met someone motivated enough to wipe the smug look off his face.
Safe to say, he had finally met one.

chapters.title: Chapter 1909 Meeting Crimson Dagger
paragraphs: Vexthra and her sisters entered the restaurant and immediately spotted a man clad in a crimson cloak seated at the corner, facing the window.
Kent had already told them what to do and who to look out for.
So the moment they spotted him, they moved toward his table, and when they were close, Vexthra said...
"The black sheep is always..."
The man turned and looked at them, then continued the statement Vexthra had started: "...ready to be slaughtered by the butcher even if it has done nothing wrong."

"So you are Crimson Dagger, the Crimson Dagger?" Vexthra asked, having heard a lot about this man. Although she isn't a fangirl, it is hard not to be impressed by the feats fo such a legendary figure.
He is part of the seven Supreme Leaders of the Midnight Shadows.
His legendary feats had long since gone down in history, ranking him among some of the greatest assassins to ever walk the face of this universe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1910 Beast Kingdom
paragraphs: Why did they laugh?
It was because the Guardian of the Beast Kingdom was a member of the 13 Divine Wonders, the legendary beasts that once followed the Divine Beast Tamer.

And as it happened, the Divine Beast Tamer was Kent. But even if he wasn't, they had Yukiko, who was a member of the 13 Divine Wonders. If they wished to see the Guardian, they just had to tell her, and she would take them.
Already, they had plans to go to the Beast Kingdom and inform the Guardian that their master was back, and so they should get the gang back together.

Crimson Dagger furrowed his brow when he heard what they said. In the end, however, he chose not to pry into their business. His job was to make sure they succeeded, and that was what he would do and had already started doing.

"Since that is the case, then I will leave that matter with you ladies. For now, we have to discuss how the attack will happen. We have three strongholds, meaning we need three teams. I have started assembling a team to handle the attacks.
I propose that when we find the true stronghold, the Midnight Shadows will handle the other two, and you ladies, since you wish to focus on the main one, will handle that.

chapters.title: Chapter 1911 Neveross, the Abyssal Soul Leviathan
paragraphs: Yukiko and her sisters appeared in a not-too-luxurious garden, but they were immediately taken aback by what they saw.
It was just that everything about this garden reeked of power and danger. It felt like every blade of grass could cut deep into their soul and wound even their Dao Heart.

And seated at the center of the garden was a man clad in a blue set of well-designed robes, his wavy blue hair falling down his back. He was tall, perhaps closer to 7 feet, and well-built, athletic even.
He didn't appear to be dangerous, yet Vexthra and her sisters came to a halt when they laid eyes on him. It was as if his mere presence was death, and they could feel it deep in their souls.
'This man is dangerous, and he is only a Pseudo-Primordial,' Eliza, who was the strongest of them, said inwardly, making sure she stood in front of her sisters just in case this man tried to attack.

"Relax, ladies, that is just how he is. His presence naturally makes one tremble deep within their soul," Yukiko said, a smirk forming on her face as she gazed at the man whom she would never forget, even if her memories were wiped.
After all, long before they met, she saw him in one of her divinations, long before the Divine Beast Tamer tamed him and made him one of the 13 Divine Wonders.

"Hey, Neveross, aren't you afraid I will tell Master you scared his wives?" Yukiko threatened, and it worked. The moment the words came out, the intimidating presence in the air vanished, allowing Vexthra and her sisters to breathe.

chapters.title: Chapter 1912 Parting Ways
paragraphs: From the information they had read in the soul manual, the main stronghold of the Grim Arcane Legends is located somewhere in the Eastern Celestial Zone.
Of course, even though they don't know everything yet, they know it is heavily protected and highly secured.

Getting in would be very hard. Luckily, the ladies had the right person to sneak in and allow the others access. That person was none other than Liora, who, from her early days, was a rather unruly child.
She had a rather extensive rap sheet to her name.
Apparently, before she became an assassin and terrorized many people, she was an expert criminal who, over two decades, stole from even immortals and gods while still mortal.

She dared not tell Kent this, but she revealed it to her sisters, and from what she said, she was pretty good at infiltration. Now that she was a demigod, who was to say she couldn't even steal from Primordials?
So getting in would be handled by her.

chapters.title: Chapter 1913 Battlefield Matrix Version 1.0
paragraphs: It took some time for Alina to deploy all the formations she had cooked up for the valley they had found and would be using as their safe zone.
They also left their markers there so they could easily teleport there if they found themselves in trouble while traversing the dangerous and vast expanse of Flame Paradise.
For now, they just wanted to make sure it was protected.

"Nicely done, Alina," Kent said, planting a kiss on Alina's cheek, his other hand resting on her ass. As the one with the biggest butt in the harem, Kent loved to give more attention to her butt whenever he could.
Alina smiled and allowed herself to melt into Kent's arms.
A few moments later, she asked, "So where are we off to next?"
"Since we have no map of this place, we have to find others who do. But for that to happen, we must first ensure your Battlefield Matrix is complete, or at least the first phase is complete.
This place is dangerous, so making sure your most precious creation is complete will surely come in handy when the dangers start to overwhelm us."

chapters.title: Chapter 1914 Legendary Creation
paragraphs: Alina aspired to create a formation that worked without her commanding it.
In this sense, when danger arises, the formation would assess its severity and act accordingly. If it needed to defend, it would, and if it needed to attack, it would.
Of course, all of this would be made possible by Alina's own judgment. She created it, so what she knew went into the formation and how it was meant to work.
Her sisters had helped her, but she knew the person who could help her the most was none other than Kent, who had lived many lives and, in all of them, had fought in legendary battles.
His legendary battles had given him extensive battlefield experience. So, with his help, she knew she would be creating something good.
Finally, after 1 million arrays and several million runes, she was done with version one. And while it was just the first version, there was just no way it could be underestimated.
"This is going to be my life's work," Alina said, a tear dropping from her eyes.

She came up with this formation after Camilla nearly died during one of their battles in the Planet Killer dungeon a few years back. Since then, she had done everything she could to make sure the Battlefield Matrix became a thing.

chapters.title: Chapter 1915 The Call
paragraphs: BOOM
A heavy explosion rocked a rocky terrain, sending shards of stone flying around. Aside from the stones, blood also splattered into the air, and smoke from the explosion obscured the terrain.
Standing at the center of this explosion was, of course, Alina, surrounded by the dead bodies of beasts, most of them at the demigod stage, though a few god-level beasts were among their ranks.
Kent stood beside her, his arms folded over his chest, a look of intrigue crossing his face.
It had been a day since Alina improved the Battlefield Matrix, making it more energy-efficient. Since then, they had been attacking just about any beast they saw with it.
After a day of constant battles, he had come to the conclusion that against supreme-level beasts and above, if there were multiple targets, killing them using the Battlefield Matrix would be hard.
The Battlefield Matrix worked well against even multiple God-level beasts, but when they faced supreme-level beasts, it took time and a lot of energy to handle them.
Luckily for them, the majority of the cores harvested from their battles went back into empowering the formation, so Alina herself didn't have to use her energy.

A heavy explosion rocked a rocky terrain, sending shards of stone flying around.
Aside from the stones, blood also splattered into the air, and smoke from the explosion obscured the terrain.
Standing at the center of this explosion was, of course, Alina, surrounded by the dead bodies of beasts, most of them at the demigod stage, though a few god-level beasts were among their ranks.
Kent stood beside her, his arms folded over his chest, a look of intrigue crossing his face.
It had been a day since Alina improved the Battlefield Matrix, making it more energy-efficient.
Since then, they had been attacking just about any beast they saw with it.
After a day of constant battles, he had come to the conclusion that against supreme-level beasts and above, if there were multiple targets, killing them using the Battlefield Matrix would be hard.
The Battlefield Matrix worked well against even multiple God-level beasts, but when they faced supreme-level beasts, it took time and a lot of energy to handle them.
Luckily for them, the majority of the cores harvested from their battles went back into empowering the formation, so Alina herself didn't have to use her energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1916 Revenge Is a Bitch (1)
paragraphs: "What happened, Kent?" Alina asked in a worried tone, staring at Kent's pale face.
He smiled and cupped her cheeks. "Relax, Alina, I am fine."
"Then what happened? Why did you suddenly scream?"

"I had an unannounced and unexpected visit from my unruly weapon, which had been held captive somewhere in this dreadful place. It had given me the direction, and so that is where I will be going next."
"You mean we will be going," Alina corrected, but Kent smiled and shook his head.
"No, I will be continuing alone from here onwards. Your sisters are almost ready to attack the Grim Arcane Legends, and they are going to need your help, so go help them."

Alina frowned. "They haven't attacked yet, which means we still have time to ourselves. So until they attack, I will keep moving with you. Plus, you need someone to watch your back just in case you have another episode."
